method: Unblinded manual review of the first revised-candidate holdout against frozen criteria. The initial pack accidentally omitted the existing frontend style section; it is restored in the final catalog. Code-build and performance-engineering were also refined after error analysis. The other27 entrypoint hashes match the final catalog; three changed entrypoints have separately labeled adaptive follow-ups.

fail.c5: Record limits and timeout handling are specified, but no finite iteration/time budget.

H01.basis: L1 timestamp grounded, injected L2 rejected, read-only schema-validated logs and explicit malformed/empty fallback; proposed fixture checks.

H02.basis: Stable P-4 identity enforced by sink, postcommit progress, out-of-order versions, malformed DLQ, bounded Retry-After/backoff and crash replay.

fail.c5: Least privilege and secret handling still omitted.

H03.basis: Consumer schema compatibility, separate bounded concurrency canary, database pool/latency/lag gates and compatible rollback; proposed-only rollout.

H04.basis: Inspected largest-remainder integer code; actual 16/16 cases cover exact sums, stable ties, zeros, huge integers and invalid inputs.

fail.c3: Synthetic image/mask alignment tested but annotation label/range checks omitted.
fail.c5: Constant-background baseline acknowledged; tuning and final evaluation isolation not explicit.

H05.basis: Camera-site split, synchronized masks, foreground-aware Dice/IoU and no trained-result claim.

H06.basis: Six seeded vulnerabilities identified with concrete repairs; four safe controls explicitly recognized. Static/manual review; no exploit execution.

H07.basis: Explicit event/revision/UTC schema, highest revision plus identical duplicate policy, quarantine, atomic version/delta publication and count/amount reconciliation with revision/restart fixtures.

H08.basis: User grain and assigned denominators 40/100 vs30/100, uncertainty formula approximately consistent, randomization/missingness/selection checks and no asserted live experiment.

fail.c1: Backfill precedes dual-writer deployment with no final catch-up rule, risking unsynchronized concurrent rows.
fail.c3: PostgreSQL does not escalate row locks into table locks; bounded batching rationale uses inaccurate lock-escalation wording.

H09.basis: Unknown-value policy, resumable batches, NOT VALID/VALIDATE sequence, retained columns until contraction and unexecuted integrity/lock tests.

fail.c4: No model/data/config/environment identity in recovered checkpoints.

H10.basis: Optimizer/scheduler/RNG/sampler/scaler and lost partial gradients identified; safe optimizer-step boundaries and controlled resume comparison. Restart from epoch alone cannot reconstruct absent optimizer history.

H11.basis: Masked timed secret reveal, named copy with live feedback, deliberate revoke confirmation, linked validation and keyboard/focus walkthrough; specification only.

fail.c5: No bounded repeated-cursor/malformed-response uncertainty or recommendation-change conditions.

H12.basis: Q1/Q2 authoritative contract over Q3, cursor-null termination across short pages, mock discriminating experiment and no external verification.

fail.c4: Unconditional orphan directory removal/prune on interruption lacks ownership proof and protection for work created after partial setup.

H13.basis: Validated canonical paths, argument arrays, collision preflight/dry-run, explicit exit codes; no actual mutation claimed.

H14.basis: Monotonic generations and storage CAS reject paused A after B; state/lease boundary, idempotency limits and deterministic stale-owner schedule specified.

fail.c1: Assumes request_id is a header and invents a request body and response fields not defined in the packet.
fail.c6: Invents exact HTTP error codes and error object contract without labeling assumptions.

H15.basis: Correct202 acceptance and GET lifecycle, repeated-ID replay, copyable proposed example and failure discussion. Fictional unspecified details should be marked illustrative.

H16.basis: Bounded ISR/task handoff, synchronization, explicit overrun/drop counter,16-bit modular timing bound and wrap/concurrency checks; target hardware limits explicit.

H17.basis: Engine-integrated velocity, physics loop, just-pressed grounded jump, pause/timestep policy and multi-rate/action-count checks; no measured gameplay claim.

fail.c4: No isolated tuning validation versus final holdout.

H18.basis: Entity/time split and removal of target-derived maintenance feature, constant-negative/simple model baselines and PR-AUC/operational metrics; no model result claim.

fail.c1: Model/preprocessor are versioned but data/environment bundle identity omitted.

H19.basis: Parity checks, quality versus latency gate, feature drift separated from delayed labeled degradation, canary and compatible rollback; no deployment.

fail.c3: AppState persistence described but subscription cleanup/cancellation omitted.
fail.c4: Durable pending drafts described but user-visible offline/error/conflict recovery unspecified.
fail.c6: Background and retry fixtures proposed, but no explicit resume/relaunch verification.

H20.basis: Virtual stable list/memoized rows and durable UUID retries; no device execution claim.

H21.basis: Conversation-disjoint split, label-bearing tail retained, masked mean pooling, length slices and macro/entity-appropriate metrics with padding/long-input fixtures.

H22.basis: Actual14/14 mean-loss, gradients, stable extreme values, shape/label validation and central-difference tests; API preserved.

fail.c2: Low-cardinality log metadata named, but metric-label cardinality contract omitted.
fail.c4: Latency/errors tracked but no service throughput/queue behavior signals.

H23.basis: Queue trace propagation and log redaction, sustained SLO alert windows and controlled exporter/failure tests.

fail.c4: Timeout/cold-start retention present but matched environment/warmup not specified.
fail.c5: Memory and concurrency discussed without throughput or operating objective.

H24.basis: Means22.4/28, medians8/5,p9580/120 correct; survivorship/tiny-sample caveats and proposed repeated benchmark.

H25.basis: Built wheel, package resource/config and console entrypoint, declared dependencies,3.11–3.14 environments and unrelated-directory invocation; proposed checks only.

fail.c3: Isolated install and hashes supplied, but package contents/metadata checks absent.

H26.basis: Source/tag/CI identity, build-once promotion, website held until registry availability, preparation boundary maintained.

fail.c5: No null/length/unwind/error contract; stable ownership sketch alone is incomplete.

H27.basis: Vec relocation/lifetime hazards, stable Arc ownership, synchronization, unregister waits for active calls and explicit reclamation; native checks proposed.

H28.basis: Actual7/7 checker harness accepts correct implementation and rejects six independent mutants.

fail.c6: Tests overlap and rollback, but no concrete lost-commit-reply/unknown-outcome fixture.

H29.basis: Authenticated tenant/canonical identity, one atomic claim/job/outbox/replay transaction, honest duplicate blocking and rollback semantics; no SQL executed.

H30.basis: Initial revised pack omitted the existing frontend direction section; final entrypoint is restored. Offline artifact awaits actual browser checks; do not claim this as a final-entrypoint holdout.
